properties.name: model-cards:integration_means
properties.value: Hugging Face transformers (AutoModelForCausalLM/AutoTokenizer with apply_chat_template, bf16); GGUF builds for llama.cpp (llama-cli); evaluated via vLLM backend; model emits a <think>…</think> block before the answer; greedy decoding (do_sample=False) with ≥2048 new tokens recommended

properties.name: model-cards:distribution_channels
properties.value: Open weights on Hugging Face in this repository (safetensors bf16 plus Q4_K_M / Q5_K_M / Q6_K / Q8_0 / F16 GGUF builds for llama.cpp); the TwIL-LM3* weights are not yet released.

modelParameters.architectureFamily: SmolLM3 decoder-only transformer; 36 layers, hidden size 2048
modelParameters.modelArchitecture: SmolLM3 decoder-only transformer; 36 layers, hidden size 2048; 3.08B total parameters; 128,256 vocabulary; 65,536-token context window. No rationale for the design choices is given.

performanceMetrics.value: TwIL-LM3 Track A (in-domain): lean_formalize token_f1 0.5869; rule_induction derivation 0.3192; entailment_label accuracy 0.5750; semantic_parse token_f1 0.4416; lean_critic accuracy 0.6600; macro gate 0.4218; strict-7 0.1971. Track B (held-out): gsm8k 0.8733; svamp 0.8500; macro (10 CoT datasets) 0.7339; macro (all 14) 0.6694.

useCases: A 3B reasoning model for formal logic tasks: FOL translation, entailment labels, semantic parses, Lean formalisation and Lean proof critique. It is not a general assistant or chat model.
technicalLimitations: Truncation: 4.4% of Track A generations hit the 2048-token cap, so the macro gate is indicative rather than exact. Scope is limited to formal logic; code generation and tool use not evaluated. Not a chat model: no safety tuning beyond the base model's and no instruction-following alignment (IFEval regressed slightly). A short generation budget truncates the <think> reasoning and scores far worse.

out_of_scope_uses: Not a general assistant or chat model; it is tuned for formal logic only. It has no safety tuning beyond the base model's and no instruction-following alignment (IFEval regressed slightly). No claim is made about code generation or tool use.

properties.name: model-cards:design_rationale
properties.value: WiSE-FT interpolation toward the base with λ = 0.25 (only a quarter of the fine-tuned delta retained), chosen by constrained optimisation (maximise in-domain score subject to minimal held-out degradation) so held-out capability survives. Checkpoint fusion averaged intermediate SFT checkpoints selected by a diversity probe rather than the final checkpoint. MGPO (entropy-weighted GRPO) used partial credit for loose matches and token-F1 so all-fail prompt groups still produce gradient. A sibling arm without the conservative interpolation scored higher in-domain but lost about twelve points of held-out capability; this release is the balanced point of that trade.

properties.name: model-cards:required_hardware
properties.value: Q4_K_M GGUF build (1.78 GiB) runs on CPU or 4 GB of VRAM

properties.name: model-cards:eval_methodology
properties.value: Track A: n = 200 per objective, greedy (temperature = 0), max_new_tokens = 2048, one retry at 4096 for truncated rows, max_seq_len = 8192, seed 42. Track B: 300 examples per task, greedy, max_gen_toks = 4096, max_model_len = 8192, repetition_penalty = 1.0, chat template applied, vLLM backend. Same protocol for model and base in a paired run over identical sampled rows.
